description: This class implements a table model for displaying and managing a list of LoggerData objects in a GUI, including selection and data unit handling.

classes.name: ParameterListTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying LoggerData items, allowing selection and unit display, used in GUI tables.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the model.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of a specific column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Determines if a cell is editable based on the column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific row and column.

methods.name: setValueAt
methods.description: Sets the value at a specific row and column, supporting cell editing.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in a column.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a LoggerData to the table, with an initial selection state.

methods.name: selectParam
methods.description: Updates the selection state of a specific LoggerData item.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all data and unregisters all LoggerData from the broker.

methods.name: getParameterRows
methods.description: Returns a list of all ParameterRow objects currently managed.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Private method to update selection status and register/deregister logger data accordingly.
